Package com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.lifecycle

Class LifecycleManager

java.lang.Object
com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.lifecycle.LifecycleManager
public class LifecycleManager extends Object
Orchestrates the deployment lifecycle of a model version: 
 resolve provider → validate (initialize) → warm (optional probe) → atomic swap → drain → retire old

This is the separation the v1.0 architecture calls for: InferenceEngine implementations know nothing about versioning, traffic splitting, or deployment safety — they just load a model and answer infer() calls. LifecycleManager is solely responsible for deciding when a new version is safe to receive traffic and for making cutovers atomic and graceful.

Beyond the base validate/warm/swap/retire flow, this class also supports:

  • Graceful draining — a retiring engine is only closed once its in-flight requests finish (or a timeout elapses), so hot swaps under load never sever in-progress calls.
  • Rollback — rollback(String) redeploys the last known-good (previously active) version.
  • Canary deployments — deployCanary(com.codedstream.otterstream.inference.config.ModelConfig, int) runs a new version alongside the current primary at a configurable traffic percentage; promoteCanary(java.lang.String) or rollbackCanary(java.lang.String) conclude it.
  • Shadow deployments — deployShadow(java.lang.String, com.codedstream.otterstream.inference.config.ModelConfig, double) mirrors a sampled copy of traffic to a version asynchronously, purely for comparison, never affecting served responses.
Since:
0.1.0

    • deploy

      public ManagedModel deploy(ModelConfig config, Map<String,Object> warmupProbe) throws DeploymentException
      Deploys (or hot-swaps) a model version as the primary.

      The new version is validated and warmed independently of whatever is currently active; only once that succeeds is it atomically swapped in. The previously-active engine is then drained (in-flight requests allowed to finish, up to the configured drain timeout) and closed.

      Parameters:
      config - the model configuration to deploy
      warmupProbe - optional sample input map exercised once before the swap; empty map skips warmup
      Returns:
      the ManagedModel now serving this version
      Throws:
      DeploymentException - if resolving a provider, validation, or warmup fails

    • rollback

      public ManagedModel rollback(String modelId) throws DeploymentException
      Re-deploys the last previously-active (retired) version for a model, effectively undoing the most recent hot swap. This goes through the full validate/warm flow again — it does not reuse the old, already-closed engine instance.
      Parameters:
      modelId - the model id to roll back
      Returns:
      the managed model, now back on the rolled-back version
      Throws:
      DeploymentException - if the rollback deployment itself fails validation/warmup
      IllegalStateException - if there is no prior retired version with a usable config

    • deployCanary

      public ManagedModel deployCanary(ModelConfig config, int trafficPercent) throws DeploymentException
      Deploys a candidate version alongside the current primary, receiving trafficPercent percent of ManagedModel.infer(Map) calls (routed randomly per-call).
      Parameters:
      config - the candidate model configuration
      trafficPercent - percentage of traffic (0-100) to route to the canary
      Returns:
      the managed model, now serving both primary and canary
      Throws:
      DeploymentException - if validation/warmup of the canary fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if trafficPercent is outside 0-100

    • promoteCanary

      public void promoteCanary(String modelId)
      Promotes the current canary to primary: the canary's engine becomes the new primary (no re-validation needed, it's already warm and serving traffic), the canary slot is cleared, and the old primary is drained and retired.
      Parameters:
      modelId - the model id whose canary should be promoted
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no canary is currently deployed

    • rollbackCanary

      public void rollbackCanary(String modelId)
      Discards the current canary without touching the primary: closes (after draining) the canary's engine and clears the canary slot.
      Parameters:
      modelId - the model id whose canary should be discarded
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no canary is currently deployed

    • deployShadow

      public ManagedModel deployShadow(String modelId, ModelConfig config, double sampleRate) throws DeploymentException
      Deploys a shadow version: every call to ManagedModel.infer(Map) that's sampled in (per sampleRate) is also, asynchronously and without affecting the caller, sent to this engine. Results are reported to any registered ShadowListener.
      Parameters:
      modelId - the model id to attach the shadow to (must already have a primary deployed)
      config - the shadow model configuration
      sampleRate - fraction of traffic to mirror to the shadow, from 0.0 (off) to 1.0 (all)
      Returns:
      the managed model, now shadowing traffic to this version
      Throws:
      DeploymentException - if validation/warmup of the shadow fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if sampleRate is outside 0.0-1.0

    • stopShadow

      public void stopShadow(String modelId)
      Stops shadowing traffic for a model: clears the shadow slot and retires (drains + closes) its engine. No-op if no shadow is deployed.
      Parameters:
      modelId - the model id to stop shadowing

    • undeploy

      public void undeploy(String modelId)
      Removes a model entirely and closes (after draining) its primary, canary, and shadow engines, if present. Best-effort: close failures are logged, not thrown.
      Parameters:
      modelId - the model id to undeploy

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Shuts down the shadow-inference thread pool. Call once when the owning OtterRuntime is closed; the manager should not be reused afterward.
